draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Understood on taking another week to decide -- I won't crowd you in the meantime. Also, the webhook payload issue you raised is resolved on our end; do flag it if it crops up again.

One thing that often makes the evaluation easier: getting a teammate in alongside you, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and I'm happy to help with that one step whenever you're ready.

Best,
Priya
